name: Itabuna

queries.query: Itabuna Bahia official cadastral parcel map geospatial API prefeitura cadastro imobiliario
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the official Prefeitura de Itabuna portal, its Secretaria de Planejamento, and an official 2022 procurement document describing a planned municipal cadastral GIS with parcel-map access. No current public parcel-vector endpoint was found.

queries.query: Itabuna mapa cadastral parcelas terreno oficial prefeitura cadastro imobiliário
queries.result: A busca nativa found the official municipal portal and current municipal notices referring to Cadastro Imobiliário Municipal, cartographic records, and urban-management systems. The official portal exposed no public parcel map/API in the bounded inspection.

officialSourceAssessment.nationalService: No national cadastral parcel service was qualified for this city in the bounded research.
officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: The official Prefeitura Municipal de Itabuna portal and Secretaria de Planejamento identify the municipality as the local planning and territorial-management custodian. Municipal notices identify the Cadastro Imobiliário Municipal and SIURB as responsible for cartographic and urban records.
officialSourceAssessment.registryEvidence: Local custodian evidence is present, but it is not evidence of a currently open parcel-vector service or complete public registry coverage.

requestOutcomes: TLS-verified anonymous GET requests reached the official municipal portal, services page, planning-secretariat page, and the official procurement/document URLs found in first-party discovery. The current portal HTML and linked public service content were inspected for cadastral, parcel, map, geoprocessing, and API links. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe field request, or TLS exception was used. No safe parcel ID-plus-geometry response qualified.

attemptedRoutes.outcome: Official municipal portal loaded; no parcel map or public cadastral API link exposed in the bounded HTML inspection.
Official services page loaded; no public cadastral parcel viewer or vector endpoint was exposed.
Official planning-secretariat page confirms territorial/planning and land-control responsibilities; no parcel geometry service exposed.
Officially published municipal procurement document describes desired cadastral GIS functions, including parcel-map lookup and exports, but is a specification rather than a live service or response.
Official notice states the integrated urban/licensing and territorial-management system was being initiated; it does not publish an anonymous parcel API.
Public FBDS directory exposed environmental APP shapefile downloads, not cadastral parcels; not retained as parcel evidence.
Official IBGE census-sector map confirms municipal context and SIRGAS 2000 map metadata, but contains no cadastral parcel polygons or parcel identities.
